armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN GRACE
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be used against enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: FIERY BREATH
armySpecialRules.description: A model with this special rule has a Strength 4 Breath Weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: LILEATH'S BLESSING
armySpecialRules.description: A Wizard with this special rule gains a +1 dispel bonus.

armySpecialRules.name: MARTIAL PROWESS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule may re-roll all To Hit rolls of 1 when making close combat attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: SWORDMASTER
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule ignore Initiative penalties from great weapons and gain the Dodge (6+) special rule against non-magical missile attacks with Strength 3 or below (except templates).

armySpecialRules.name: VALOUR OF AGES
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule re-roll all failed Panic tests caused by Dark Elves.

armySpecialRules.name: BOW OF AVELORN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 4 | Armour Piercing (1), Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN SHORTBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), March & Shoot, Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not marched. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN LONGBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: DRAGON ARMOUR
armySpecialRules.description: Heavy armour. Models with dragon armour gain a Magical Ward (6+) and the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: LION CLOAK
armySpecialRules.description: The bearer gains the Natural Armour (6+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: DEATHSINGER
magicItems.description: At the beginning of each round of close combat, roll a D3; the result is the number you may increase the wielder's Weapon Skill, Strength and Attacks by.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF AGES
magicItems.description: The Sword of Ages gives the wielder +1 To Hit, +2 Strength and +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF THE PHOENIX
magicItems.description: The Blade of the Phoenix gives the wielder the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. Once per battle, at the start of any close combat phase the wielder can unleash the full power of the sword. For the remainder of that close combat phase, they get the Always Strikes First special rule and +D6 Attacks.

magicItems.name: BOW OF THE SEAFARER
magicItems.description: The Bow of the Seafarer is a Bolt Thrower.

magicItems.name: CLOUDCLEAVER
magicItems.description: All attacks made with Cloudcleaver have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. In addition, it gives the wielder the Fear special rule and against War Beasts and Cavalry, they cause Terror.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF THE SHORES
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and +2 Attacks.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF VICTORY
magicItems.description: The Sword of Victory gives the wielder the Always Strikes First and Armour Piercing (1) special rules. In addition, they will always Wound on a 3+ or better.

magicItems.name: THE REAVER BOW
magicItems.description:
The Reaver Bow has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
20/30" | 5 | Armour Piercing (1), March & Shoot, Multiple Shots (3)

magicItems.name: THE BLADE OF LEAPING GOLD
magicItems.description: The Blade of Leaping Gold grants the wielder +3 Attacks. In addition, any roll of 6 To Wound made with the Blade of Leaping Gold Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF DARTING STEEL
magicItems.description: The Blade of Darting Steel gives the wielder +1 To Hit and the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF HOETH
magicItems.description: All hits with the Sword of Hoeth wound automatically. Armour saves are modified by the Strength of the bearer.

magicItems.name: DRAGONBLADE LANCE
magicItems.description: During turns in which the wielder of the Dragonblade Lance charges, it automatically hits all models in one file that is in base contact rather than fighting normally. Hits are resolved as that from a Bolt Thrower, except the Strength does not decrease for each rank.

magicItems.name: JADE BOW
magicItems.description: All shots from the Jade Bow are resolved at Strength 4. In addition, if you successfully Wound your target, you may fire an additional shot against the same target. You may continue to fire additional shots until you fail to Hit, Wound or the target is dead.

magicItems.name: FOE BANE
magicItems.description: Against Monstrous Infantry, Monstrous Cavalry, Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures and Monsters, this sword will always wound on a 2+.

magicItems.name: BOW OF TOR ALESSI
magicItems.description: The Bow of Tor Alessi has the Quick Shot special rule. In addition, it may re-roll any failed To Hit rolls.

magicItems.name: THE GOLDEN SHIELD
magicItems.description: Infantry or Cavalry only. Enemies must re-roll all successful To Hit rolls against the bearer of the Golden Shield.

magicItems.name: HELM OF FORTUNE
magicItems.description: The Helm of Fortune gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. The wearer may re-roll failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF HEROES
magicItems.description: In order to allocate close combat attacks against the wearer, each enemy model must first pass a Leadership test at the start of each close combat phase. If the test is failed, the model may not attack at all this round.

magicItems.name: DRAGONSCALE SHIELD
magicItems.description: The Dragonscale Shield adds an additional +1 armour save as well as the Magical Ward (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF ITHINAR
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks against the bearer suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: TEMAKADOR'S GAUNTLETS
magicItems.description: Temakador's Gauntlets gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, they gain the Magical Ward (5+) special rule against attacks of Strength 4 or greater.

magicItems.name: WYRMSCALE ARMOUR OF THE DEEP
magicItems.description: The Wyrmscale Armour of the Deep gives the wearer the Aquatic and Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rules.

magicItems.name: SHADOW ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Strider special rule. In addition, no enemies can draw Line of Sight to them unless they are within 6".

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF STARS
magicItems.description: If the wearer of the Armour of Stars suffers an unsaved wound (but is not slain) they can choose to instantly teleport 3D6" in a random direction (placing it at least 1" away from other units or impassable terrain) with its front arc in a direction of your choosing. If the model teleports off the table, then treat this as it having pursued off the table.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF THE MERWYRM
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Shield of the Merwyrm gains the Parry (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: PINION OF THE PHOENIX
magicItems.description: The Pinion of the Phoenix gives the wearer the Magical Ward (5+) special rule. If the bearer is slain, the item is destroyed but restores the bearer to their starting Wound total and inflicts a Strength 5 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule on all models in base contact.

magicItems.name: VAMBRACES OF DEFENCE
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Magical Ward (4+) special rule. In addition, they may re-roll failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: NULL STONE
magicItems.description: No model in base contact with the bearer of the Null Stone may cast spells, and all Magic Items lose their effects; treat them as mundane versions of the same type.

magicItems.name: FOLARIATH'S ROBE
magicItems.description: The wearer of Folariath's Robe gains the Ethereal special rule.

magicItems.name: GUARDIAN PHOENIX
magicItems.description: The Guardian Phoenix gives the wearer the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) and Magical Ward (5+) special rules.

magicItems.name: LOREMASTER'S CLOAK
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Loremaster's Cloak gains the Magical Ward (3+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: THE SIGNET OF ATHINOL
magicItems.description: Any attacks made against the bearer suffer a -1 Strength penalty.

magicItems.name: SACRED INCENSE
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeted at the bearer of the Sacred Incense or the unit they are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN CROWN OF ATRAZAR
magicItems.description: The Golden Crown of Atrazar gives the bearer the Magical Ward (4+) and Stupidity special rules. In addition, at the start of each of your turns, they suffer -1 to their Leadership. This penalty is cumulative.

magicItems.name: PHOENIX STONE
magicItems.description: Every time the bearer of this item rolls a natural 6 on their armour save or invulnerable save roll, they restore 1 Wound suffered earlier during game.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF BLINDING LIGHT
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with the bearer suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF SAPHERY
magicItems.description: The Talisman of Saphery causes all Magic Weapons of enemy models in base contact to lose all their effects; treat them as mundane weapons of their type.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF FIRE
magicItems.description: The Amulet of Fire gives the wearer the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: BOOK OF HOETH
magicItems.description: The Book of Hoeth allows the bearer to re-roll a single dice from each of his casting or dispel attempts. Results of 6 cannot be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: ANNULIAN CRYSTAL
magicItems.description: During the enemy's Magic phase, the Annulian Crystal allows you to remove one dice from the opponent's Power dice pool and add it to your own Dispel dice pool.

magicItems.name: SIGIL OF ASURYAN
magicItems.description: When an enemy cast a spell, the bearer may use this item instead of attempting to dispel the spell by using dispel dice. This gives them 6 free dice to attempt to dispel the spell, which cannot be combined with any other dispel dice. In addition, the spell is destroyed and the enemy caster loses access to the spell for the rest of the game (note that this has no effect on Bound spells).

magicItems.name: SEERSTAFF OF SAPHERY
magicItems.description: The Seerstaff of Saphery gives the bearer the Loremaster special rule.

magicItems.name: TRICKSTER'S PENDANT
magicItems.description: If an enemy Wizard suffers a Miscast, the bearer of the Trickster's Pendant can choose to make the Wizard re-roll the result on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: STARWOOD STAFF
magicItems.description: The Starwood staff gives the bearer a +1 casting bonus. In addition, they may re-roll one failed channelling roll per turn.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF SOLIDITY
magicItems.description: The Staff of Solidity makes the Wizard immune to the effects of their first Miscast.

magicItems.name: JEWEL OF THE DUSK
magicItems.description: The Jewel of the Dusk gives the bearer +1 Power dice in each of your Magic phases. Only they may use this extra dice.

magicItems.name: VORTEX SHARD
magicItems.description: The bearer may use the Vortex Shard at the start of any enemy Magic phase. Your opponent must remove D3 power dice from their power pool.

magicItems.name: SILVER WAND
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Silver Wand may pick a spell one level higher than they are normally allowed.

magicItems.name: SPELL CROWN OF DUSK
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains access to a randomly generated Lvl 1 spell (which may be replaced by the Signature Spell) from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: RADIANT GEM OF HOETH
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Radiant Gem of Hoeth becomes a Level 1 Wizard using the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: KHAINE'S RING OF FURY
magicItems.description: Khaine's Ring of Fury contains the Fury of Khaine spell from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: MORANION'S WAYSHARD
magicItems.description: The bearer of Moranion's Wayshard and one friendly Infantry unit they must deploy with has the Ambushers special rule. Instead of arriving as Reinforcements, they may choose to deploy in any non-impassable terrain feature in the turn they arrive.

magicItems.name: PENDANT OF VENGEANCE
magicItems.description: When fighting Dwarfs, the bearer may force a successful Leadership test while using an Anvil of Doom or Rune Lore to be rerolled.

magicItems.name: RING OF CORIN
magicItems.description: The Ring of Corin contains the Vaul's Unmaking spell from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: SKY ARROW OF NALOER
magicItems.description:
This item cannot be used with the Sniper special rule. The Sky Arrow of Naloer has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 6 | Magical Attacks, Multiple Wounds (D6)

magicItems.name: SKEINSLIVER
magicItems.description: The Skeinsliver allows the controlling player to add +1 to the roll to determine which player can decide whether to take the first turn or not.

magicItems.name: BLESSED TOME
magicItems.description: The model gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: GEM OF SUNFIRE
magicItems.description: At the start of any of your turns, when the Gem of Sunfire is used, all of the bearer's spells, shooting attacks and close combat attacks (and their mount's, if they have one) have a +1 bonus To Wound (rolls of 1 still fail) provided that they also have the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: HORN OF ISHA
magicItems.description: The Horn of Isha can be used at the start of one of your Movement phases. For the remainder of the turn, all models in the bearer's unit receive a +1 To Hit bonus on all shooting and close combat attacks.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF THE PURIFYING FLAME
magicItems.description: Enemy spells that target the character or the unit they are with suffer a -3 casting penalty.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF THE TEMPEST
magicItems.description: Enemy Wizards within 12" of the bearer do not gain any casting bonus from their Wizard Level.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF BEARDS
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Cloak of Beards causes Fear. Against Dwarfs, the wearer causes Terror instead. However, all Dwarfs gain the Hatred special rule while attacking the wearer. In addition, at the start of each Close Combat phase, roll a D6 for each magic item carried by each Dwarf that is in base contact with the bearer. On a roll of 4+, that magic or runic item is destroyed and cannot be used for the rest of the battle; it will count as a mundane version of whatever item it is instead. Note that this has no effect on magic items that are mounts, war machines, magic items that contain bound spells that have already miscast during the game, and any magic items labelled as 'one use only' that have already been used during the game – do not roll to see if these magic items are destroyed.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF LIGHT
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks made by the bearer of the Amulet of Light and any unit they are with gain the Magical Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: GEM OF COURAGE
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Gem of Courage and any unit they are with may take any one Leadership test using the Cold-blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF LOEC
magicItems.description: The Talisman of Loec may be used at the start of any close combat phase. Until the end of the phase, the bearer may re-roll all failed rolls To Hit and wound, and any model wounded by their attacks must re-roll all successful armour saves and invulnerable saves. However, at the end of the phase, the bearer loses half of their remaining Wounds (rounding down) with no saves of any kind allowed.

magicItems.name: STAR RUBY
magicItems.description: At the start of each of your turns, all enemy units within 12" must reveal any Hidden models, upgrades and magic items they might have.

magicItems.name: BATTLE BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains a +D6 Combat Resolution bonus (roll each time it is used).

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE WORLD DRAGON
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard has the Magic Resistance (5) special rule. Furthermore, all Draconids (friend or foe) within 12" of the Banner of the World Dragon have the Stubborn special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF RESILIENCE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 Toughness.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF BALANCE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard, and any enemy unit in base contact with it, gain the Immunity (Psychology) special rule, and any Frenzy or Hatred special rule have no effect.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF SORCERY
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard adds +1 Power dice to your power pool in each of your own Magic phases.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF ELLYRION
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 Movement and the Strider special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF AVELORN
magicItems.description: Spells from the Lore of Light and the Lore of Life cast by a friendly Wizard that target the unit carrying this standard receive a +2 casting bonus. If Alarielle the Radiant is included in your army and is slain, this ability is immediately lost.
magicItems.restriction: Handmaiden of the Everqueen or Sisters of Avelorn

magicItems.name: BANNER OF LOTHERN
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: LION STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Immunity (Terror) special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF CONFIDENCE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard does not suffer -1 To Hit when using Stand & Shoot as a charge reaction.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF HIGH MAGIC
loresOfMagic.attribute: Each time a spell from the Lore of High Magic is successfully cast, the caster and their unit immediately gain a Magical Ward (6+) until the beginning of the caster's next Magic phase. This bonus is cumulative.

spells.name: DRAIN MAGIC
spells.description: Drain Magic can be cast on any unit (friend or foe) and has a range of 24". If the target is a friendly unit, Drain Magic is an augment spell. If the target is an enemy unit, Drain Magic is a hex spell. In either case, all Remains in Play spells affecting the unit are immediately dispelled, and spells lasting to the caster's next Magic phase immediately come to an end.

spells.name: APOTHEOSIS
spells.description: Apotheosis is an augment spell that targets a single model within 18". The target immediately regains a single lost Wound and gains the Fear special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: HAND OF GLORY
spells.description: Hand of Glory is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target's Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, Initiative or Movement (choose one) is increased by D3 until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: FORTUNE IS FICKLE
spells.description: Fortune is Fickle is a hex spell with a range of 24" that targets an enemy wizard. Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, whenever the targets roll a double when casting spells, that counts as a Miscast.

spells.name: CURSE OF ARROW ATTRACTION
spells.description: Curse of Arrow Attraction is a hex spell with a range of 24". Any missile attacks against the target may re-roll To Hit until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: FURY OF KHAINE
spells.description: Fury of Khaine is a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes 2D6 Strength 4 hits.

spells.name: COURAGE OF AENARION
spells.description: Courage of Aenarion is an augment aura with a range of 6". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all affected units gain the Stubborn special rule.

spells.name: GLAMOUR OF TECLIS
spells.description: Remains in Play. Glamour of Teclis is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in play, the target unit must pass a Leadership test with an additional D6 (discarding the lowest result) if they attempt to move in their Movement phase. If the test is failed, the casting player may move the unit using the Random Movement (D6) special rule instead.

spells.name: CORUSCATION OF FINREIR
spells.description: Remains in play. Coruscation of Finreir is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. While the spell is in effect, the Wizard adds 12" to the casting range of all their spells (excluding auras) and their dispel range, can draw Line of Sight in any direction and counts as having a Line of Sight value of 5.

spells.name: WALK BETWEEN WORLDS
spells.description: Walk Between Worlds is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Ethereal special rule until the end of the phase and can immediately move up to 10" as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.

spells.name: TEMPEST
spells.description: Tempest is a direct damage area spell with a range of 30" that uses the large round template. All models hit by the template suffer a Strength 3 hit (models with the Fly special rule suffer a Strength 4 hit instead). Any unit under the template suffers a -1 modifier to all To Hit rolls (both shooting and close combat) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: VAUL'S UNMAKING
spells.description: Vaul's Unmaking is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target suffers a single Wound which Ignores Armour Saves on a dice roll greater than or equal to the model's unmodified armour save (excluding Natural Armour, models without an armour save cannot be wounded). The owning player must then reveal to the caster all the magic items possessed by the target (if any). One item of your choice is destroyed and cannot be used for the rest of the game.

spells.name: FLAMES OF THE PHOENIX
spells.description: Remains in play. Flames of the Phoenix is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". Every model in the target unit takes a Strength 3 hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule. At the end of every subsequent Magic phase, every model in the target unit suffers another hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule, with the Strength of each Hit increasing by 1 every time.

elven_honours.name: ANOINTED OF ASURYAN
elven_honours.description: The model gains a 4+ invulnerable save and the Immunity (Psychology) special rule. The model must take a polearm and may be mounted on a Flamespyre Phoenix (see Rare Units) for +200 points. In addition, all models in a unit that contains an Anointed of Asuryan may re-roll invulnerable save results of 1.

elven_honours.name: BLOOD OF CALEDOR
elven_honours.description: The model gains dragon armour and the Devastating Charge special rule. The model must be mounted on an Elven Steed with ithilmar barding or a Moon Dragon. Alternatively, if the model is a Prince, they may be mounted on a Star Dragon for +390 points. If the model is a Noble, they may be mounted on a Sun Dragon for +235 points.

elven_honours.name: CHRACIAN HUNTER
elven_honours.description: The model gains a lion cloak, the Forest Strider, Multiple Wounds (2) and Stubborn special rules. The model must take a great weapon and may be mounted on a White Lion Chariot (see Special Units), replacing one of the crew, for +95 points.

elven_honours.name: COTHIQUE MARINER
elven_honours.description: The model may not take heavy armour. The model and one unit of Rangers that they must deploy with gains the Ambushers special rule.

elven_honours.name: SHADOW STALKER
elven_honours.description: The model must take an Elven shortbow or Elven longbow. They cannot take medium or heavy armour. They gain the Independent, Scouts and Sniper special rules.

elven_honours.name: BLADELORD
elven_honours.description: The model must take a great weapon. The model gains the Killing Blow and Swordmaster special rules.

elven_honours.name: ELLYRIAN OUTRIDER
elven_honours.description: The model may not take heavy armour. The model and any unit of Ellyrian Reavers they join may flee, pursuit and charge distances.

elven_honours.name: PURE OF HEART
elven_honours.description: The model and any unit they join gain the Immunity (Panic) special rule. When fighting against Dark Elves in close combat, they gain Immunity (Psychology).

elven_honours.name: GUARDIAN OF YVRESSE
elven_honours.description: The model must take a shield. If this model is in a unit of Sentinels or Wardens, that unit gains the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule.

elven_honours.name: LOTHERN SEA HELM
elven_honours.description: The model may take no other weapons besides spear, light lance and Elven shortbow, and may be mounted on a Lothern Skycutter (see Rare Units), replacing one of the crew, for +65 points. If a unit of Lothern Sea Guard contains one or more Sea Helms, they gain the Quick Shot special rule when making a Stand & Shoot charge reaction. In addition, the unit may then choose to do a Reform before moving the enemy unit.

elven_honours.name: TIRANOC CHARIOT MASTER
elven_honours.description: The model may roll an additional D6 for their Impact Hits and pick the highest result. In addition, they may re-roll failed Dangerous Terrain tests.
